title: Read a short list
summary: Haskell: Read a short list. Use a different nonempty list.
introduction: A list keeps values of one type in order. head reads the first item.
learningObjectives: Read a short list with Haskell

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
The list starts with cat. head reads that first string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: head fails on an empty list; pattern matching can handle that case.
